source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of statistical modelling (PDF 135).

blocks.text: Statistical modelling data se duniya samajhne aur mustaqbil ka andaza lagane ka tareeqa hai. Agle mahine ke grocery kharche ka andaza lagane ke liye purana kharcha dekhein: agar aap aam taur par taqreeban 10,000 rupay kharch karte hain magar yeh badalta hai, to model khandan ke size ya khaas mauqon jaise awamil shamil kar ke behtar budget bana sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Grocery model kaunse awamil shamil kar sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Purana kharcha, khandan ka size, jagah, aamdani aur khaas mauqe.

items: Statistical modelling: purane data se seekh kar pesh-goi, maslan agle mahine ka grocery bill.
